Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30000-r2 --slot 7 --why "Slot 7 is the earliest reachable point that separates both live pairs 0-5 and 1-5 at high sigma, keeping later high-value slots like 10 and 11 available for confirmation"

content.text: Slot 11 is still the earliest and best discriminator for the dominant (0,1) pair.

content.text: Support is just below theta (0.9942 vs 0.997); one confirmation observation at the earliest high-separation slot is warranted.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30000-r2 --slot 12 --why "Support for candidate 1 sits just under theta so one more confirmation at the earliest high separation slot for the remaining 0-1 pair is needed before finalizing"

content.text: Support for candidate 1 is now 0.999982, well above theta = 0.997. Finalizing.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/final-case-30000-r2 --why "Candidate 1 at period 12.49 days reached support 0.999982 exceeding theta 0.997 after a confirmation observation, resolving the alias against candidate 0 which collapsed to near zero support"

content.text:
Campaign complete and resolved.

**Result:** Candidate 1 (period ≈ 12.49 days) selected with support 0.999982 (θ = 0.997), using 4 of 6 observations.

**Path:** Initial data left candidates 0 (P≈1.09d), 1 (P≈12.20d), and 5 (P≈0.92d) as the only live options. Slot 7 collapsed candidate 5; slot 10 tightened the remaining 0-vs-1 tie only slightly; slot 11 pushed candidate 1 to 0.994 (just under θ); a final confirmation at slot 12 closed it out at 0.99998. 2 observations remained unused since resolution was reached cleanly.
